event_chain.summary: Investment designations suspended; rating feeds paused

summary: On June 11, 2026 the National Association of Insurance Commissioners identified unauthorized access to its Oracle PeopleSoft systems, part of a ShinyHunters campaign exploiting a PeopleSoft zero-day that was patched on June 10. ShinyHunters claimed the attack on June 18, set a deadline for contact, and after NAIC did not pay posted 3.1 TB of data around June 28, including more than 264,000 insurer filing PDFs, about 45,000 credit-rating-agency files, about 2,000 customer order records with names and emails, AWS logs and configuration files, and SQL scripts with stored credentials. NAIC said core systems and personal policyholder data were not affected, but it suspended issuing investment designations while rating agencies paused their data feeds.
